name: IPCAI 2025 paired X-ray and CT set of the distal femur (Flepp 2025, Zenodo 15753063)

pairing.xray: 50 calibrated X-rays, ten views of each specimen about 9 degrees apart (Siemens Fluorospot)
pairing.masks: contour masks and bone surface meshes
pairing.annotate: nothing for the spine; a registration benchmark
pairing.pair_key: the specimen: its ten views and its CT

what: one zip, dataset_ipcai.zip, 6.7 GB (md5 cc8bf3e445495d2deb6d50dd058dc977): 50 real calibrated X-rays of 5 cadaveric distal femur specimens (ten views each, about 9 degrees apart, Siemens Fluorospot), their 5 CTs at 0.2 mm slices, the poses, the contour masks and bone surface meshes, from 'Automatic multi-view X-ray/CT registration using bone substructure contours' (Flepp and others, IPCAI 2025, arXiv 2506.13292); the femur, no spine
level_truth: none; no spine; the stored poses make it a 2D/3D registration benchmark

segmentations.masks: contour masks and bone surface meshes of the distal femur, in dataset_ipcai.zip
